title: Quest text says 'Find Camp Gallows and ask after him by name' for Lys's brother, but after visiting every NPC I could find at Camp Gallows (Sergeant Coe, Captain Vane, Quartermaster Bray, the cook) and roughly 20 surrounding forest rooms, no dialogue option ever let me actually ask after him by name or learn his name -- the thread never advanced past 'find Camp Gallows.'
